## %CAR+ traceability chain

%CAR+ is the release test FC-CAR, measured by AM-FC-CAR and specified at ≥20% of CD3+ in PPQ-001 criterion 8. It is driven by MOI, time from activation to transduction, and vector storage. The chain has one serious problem: a freezer excursion that the risk file and the deviations do not connect to the drop in %CAR+. Several controls also have gaps.

### 1. Process parameters that drive %CAR+
| Parameter | Set at | Criticality | PPQ-001 limit | Observed in PPQ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MOI (TU/cell) | Transduction | CPP | 4.0–6.0 (crit 1) | 5.0 in all 5 PPQ batches |
| Time activation→transduction (h) | Transduction | CPP | 20–30 (crit 5) | 21.9–23.7 |
| Vector storage temperature | Material handling, upstream of transduction | KPP | none in PPQ-001 | FRZ-80-01 for both PPQ vector lots |

Seeding density (crit 2) also sits in PPQ-001 and was 0.47–0.54 in PPQ, within 0.4–0.6.

The DoE-MOI runs show a saturating dose response (same vector lot family, MOI 2.5 → 5 → 10 → 15 gives roughly 21% → 39% → 65% → 76% CAR+). CC-26-022 (open, in impact assessment) proposes raising target MOI to 8.0, which is outside the 4–6 hard stop in CS-EBR-03 and PPQ-001 criterion 1. That change is not yet linked to CS-EBR-03 or URS-EBR-009.

### 2. Risks that threaten %CAR+ (pFMEA RA-PFMEA-001)
| Risk | Failure mode | Sev | RPN | Class | Mitigating requirements / SOPs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degradation) → %CAR+, potency | 8 | 128 | HIGH | URS-EBR-007; SOP-MFG-104 |
| FM-07 | Vector held above −70 °C (ULT failure) → TE, VCN | 8 | 96 | HIGH | URS-ULT-001, URS-ULT-002, URS-EMS-014; SOP-MAT-401 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h → TE | 6 | 54 | MEDIUM | SOP-MFG-104 only |
| FM-05 | MOI above target → VCN (not %CAR+) | 9 | 108 | HIGH | URS-EBR-007, URS-EBR-009; SOP-MFG-104 |
| FM-15 | OOS result not flagged (includes %CAR+) | 10 | 80 | HIGH | URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003 |

### 3. Controls and test evidence, with gaps
| Requirement | Risk assessment | Verification status |
|---|---|---|
| URS-EBR-007 (vector volume from MOI, cells, CoA titer) | FRA-040, HIGH, SCRIPTED | Verified: TC-OQ-EBR-04 (SCRIPTED), TX-0083 PASS 2026-03-17. No later change control. **Current.** |
| URS-EBR-009 (reject MOI outside 4.0–6.0) | FRA-042, HIGH, SCRIPTED | **Gap.** Child spec CS-EBR-03 (hard-stop range check) has no verifying test case. TC-OQ-EBR-04 verifies only CS-EBR-02. |
| URS-ULT-001 (≤ −70 °C under load) | FRA-008, HIGH | Verified on FRZ-80-02 after CC-26-014 by TX-0091 PASS 2026-04-24. Loaded PQ (TX-0044) predates the compressor replacement. Judgement call for QA. |
| URS-ULT-002 (high-temp alarm at −70 °C) | FRA-009, HIGH | Verified: TX-0092 PASS 2026-04-24 on FRZ-80-02, after CC-26-014. Current. |
| URS-EMS-014 (on-call escalation within 15 min) | FRA-027, HIGH | **Stale.** Verified by TC-OQ-EMS-04 (TX-0070, 2026-01-20) against CS-EMS-03. CC-26-011 modified CS-EMS-03 (impl 2026-03-16) and stated "no re-testing required", but the verification rule requires re-verification after a change. |
| FM-08 timing control | Not assessed (no FRA row) | **Gap.** Mitigated only by SOP-MFG-104; no requirement or test. PPQ criterion 5 is the only evidence. |
| URS-LIMS-002 / URS-LIMS-003 (second-person review, OOS flagging) | FRA-031 / FRA-032 | **Gap.** No verifying test cases. |

Other notes:
- SOP-MFG-104 (v2.0) is the transduction SOP and is cited against FM-05, FM-06 and FM-08. CC-26-022 would revise it.
- The FM-06 control is "CoA titer", which is a single value captured at vector receipt. Nothing re-tests the titer in use.

### 4. How %CAR+ is measured and validated
- Method AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry, % of CD3+), status VALIDATED, validated range 5–90%.
- Validation evidence: TC-AMV-CAR-01 (SCRIPTED), TX-0086 PASS 2026-03-20. Covered by AMV-FC-CAR-01.
- Related measures: VCN-PER-CAR (≤5.0 copies per CAR+ cell, which is the CQA limit) and AM-VCN.

### 5. PPQ-001 performance (run pass/fail as recorded in the QC table)
| Batch | Vector lot | FC-CAR (%) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | LV26-007 | 44.6 | PASS |
| PPQ26-02 | LV26-007 | 39.2 | PASS |
| PPQ26-03 | LV26-007 | 36.1 | PASS |
| PPQ26-04 | LV26-021 | 38.9 | PASS |
| PPQ26-05 | LV26-021 | 37.3 | PASS |

All five PPQ batches passed the ≥20% criterion (mean ≈39%). VCN per CAR+ cell was 1.79–2.39 (limit ≤5.0). PPQ-001 status is "EXECUTION COMPLETE – REPORT PENDING". PPQ26-02 has a protocol deviation (DEV-26-033) on harvest viability (criterion 6), which is not a %CAR+ issue.

### 6. The main finding: the low-%CAR+ runs are tied to a freezer excursion, not a donor
- Vector lot LV25-118 is stored in FRZ-80-02. Before the excursion, its runs gave 34.5–41.3% CAR+ (PD26-014 to PD26-023, n=10).
- On 2026-04-20, FRZ-80-02 lost its compressor (EV-26-0009, alarm acknowledged after 11 h 20 min, by WH-02, with no escalation recorded). The historian shows the chamber at −24.7 °C on 04-20, −12.7 °C on 04-21, and about −10 °C on 04-22 and 04-23. Repair completed 04-23 (CC-26-014).
- After the excursion, LV25-118 gave 11.9–19.8% CAR+ in every run (PD26-024 to PD26-027 and ENG26-01 to ENG26-03), all at MOI 5.0 and with the same process.
- Donor HD-0118 gave 41.3% on LV25-118 on 2026-04-08 and 16.3% on 2026-04-29 on the same lot. That argues against the donor explanation in DEV-26-027 (suspected donor CD3%), which is open with CAPA-26-016.
- The vector lot was never placed on hold and no titer re-test appears in the data. The impact assessment for DEV-26-021 ("materials remained frozen, low risk") and its "max −36 °C" both conflict with the historian (about −10 °C) and with continued use of LV25-118.
- This is the FM-06/FM-07 failure scenario: a lower effective MOI with no signal in uo04. It is consistent with the data but not proven, because the titer was not re-measured. CAPA-26-008 (compressor replacement) was marked "effective, no recurrence", but its check looked for recurrence of the alarm, not for impact on the vector.
- PPQ used new lots (LV26-007, LV26-021) from FRZ-80-01, which was stable through the period checked, so PPQ is not affected by this excursion.

### 7. Deviations and what connects them
| Record | Link to %CAR+ | Status |
|---|---|---|
| DEV-26-021 (FRZ-80-02 excursion) | Links to FRZ-80-02 and CAPA-26-008. Root cause of the vector impact is not linked. | Closed |
| DEV-26-027 (low %CAR+ in ENG26-01/02) | Direct. Links to ENG26-01/02 and CAPA-26-016. Donor hypothesis contradicted by the data. | Open |
| DEV-26-033 (PPQ26-02 viability) | PPQ-001 only, not %CAR+ | Closed |
| DEV-26-041 (PPQ26-05 tubing leak) | Not %CAR+ | Open |

Change controls: CC-26-004 (PV2.0, closed, revised SOPs and pFMEA), CC-26-011 (EMS, stale verification), CC-26-014 (compressor, closed), CC-26-022 (MOI 8.0, pending).

### Summary of gaps
1. FM-06's root cause (vector potency loss after the excursion) is not in the risk file, and DEV-26-027 blames the donor. The LV25-118 lot needs a titer re-test and a disposition, and DEV-26-021's impact assessment and DEV-26-027's root cause need to be re-opened.
2. URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03 (MOI 4–6 hard stop, HIGH) has no verifying test.
3. URS-EMS-014 (HIGH) is stale after CC-26-011. The 11-hour alarm acknowledgement during the excursion shows the escalation control did not work in practice.
4. FM-08 (transduction timing) has no requirement and no FRA.
5. URS-LIMS-002/003 (FM-15, sev 10) have no verifying tests.
6. CC-26-022 (MOI 8.0) would breach CS-EBR-03 and PPQ-001 criterion 1, and that is not reflected in its trace links.

Caveat: the excursion-to-potency link is an inference from the data. Confirming it needs a titer re-test or a retained-sample study on LV25-118.

content.text:
## %CAR+ traceability chain

%CAR+ is the release test FC-CAR, measured by AM-FC-CAR and specified at ≥20% of CD3+ in PPQ-001 criterion 8. It is driven by MOI, time from activation to transduction, and vector storage. The chain has one serious problem: a freezer excursion that the risk file and the deviations do not connect to the drop in %CAR+. Several controls also have gaps.

### 1. Process parameters that drive %CAR+
| Parameter | Set at | Criticality | PPQ-001 limit | Observed in PPQ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MOI (TU/cell) | Transduction | CPP | 4.0–6.0 (crit 1) | 5.0 in all 5 PPQ batches |
| Time activation→transduction (h) | Transduction | CPP | 20–30 (crit 5) | 21.9–23.7 |
| Vector storage temperature | Material handling, upstream of transduction | KPP | none in PPQ-001 | FRZ-80-01 for both PPQ vector lots |

Seeding density (crit 2) also sits in PPQ-001 and was 0.47–0.54 in PPQ, within 0.4–0.6.

The DoE-MOI runs show a saturating dose response (same vector lot family, MOI 2.5 → 5 → 10 → 15 gives roughly 21% → 39% → 65% → 76% CAR+). CC-26-022 (open, in impact assessment) proposes raising target MOI to 8.0, which is outside the 4–6 hard stop in CS-EBR-03 and PPQ-001 criterion 1. That change is not yet linked to CS-EBR-03 or URS-EBR-009.

### 2. Risks that threaten %CAR+ (pFMEA RA-PFMEA-001)
| Risk | Failure mode | Sev | RPN | Class | Mitigating requirements / SOPs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degradation) → %CAR+, potency | 8 | 128 | HIGH | URS-EBR-007; SOP-MFG-104 |
| FM-07 | Vector held above −70 °C (ULT failure) → TE, VCN | 8 | 96 | HIGH | URS-ULT-001, URS-ULT-002, URS-EMS-014; SOP-MAT-401 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h → TE | 6 | 54 | MEDIUM | SOP-MFG-104 only |
| FM-05 | MOI above target → VCN (not %CAR+) | 9 | 108 | HIGH | URS-EBR-007, URS-EBR-009; SOP-MFG-104 |

### 6. The main finding: the low-%CAR+ runs are tied to a freezer excursion, not a donor
- Vector lot LV25-118 is stored in FRZ-80-02. Before the excursion, its runs gave 34.5–41.3% CAR+ (PD26-014 to PD26-023, n=10).
- On 2026-04-20, FRZ-80-02 lost its compressor (EV-26-0009, alarm acknowledged after 11 h 20 min, by WH-02, with no escalation recorded). The historian shows the chamber at −24.7 °C on 04-20, −12.7 °C on 04-21, and about −10 °C on 04-22 and 04-23. Repair completed 04-23 (CC-26-014).
- After the excursion, LV25-118 gave 11.9–19.8% CAR+ in every run (PD26-024 to PD26-027 and ENG26-01 to ENG26-03), all at MOI 5.0 and with the same process.
- Donor HD-0118 gave 41.3% on LV25-118 on 2026-04-08 and 16.3% on 2026-04-29 on the same lot. That argues against the donor explanation in DEV-26-027 (suspected donor CD3%), which is open with CAPA-26-016.
- The vector lot was never placed on hold and no titer re-test appears in the data. The impact assessment for DEV-26-021 ("materials remained frozen, low risk") and its "max −36 °C" both conflict with the historian (about −10 °C) and with continued use of LV25-118.
- This is the FM-06/FM-07 failure scenario: a lower effective MOI with no signal in uo04. It is consistent with the data but not proven, because the titer was not re-measured. CAPA-26-008 (compressor replacement) was marked "effective, no recurrence", but its check looked for recurrence of the alarm, not for impact on the vector.
- PPQ used new lots (LV26-007, LV26-021) from FRZ-80-01, which was stable through the period checked, so PPQ is not affected by this excursion.
